description: The plot illustrates the absolute mean of hidden states across different layers in a model, comparing three distinct scenarios. The x-axis, labeled "Layer", has a linear scale, ranges from 0 to 22, and is marked at intervals of 5. The y-axis, labeled "Abs Mean", also has a linear scale and spans from 0 to 4, with tick labels at intervals of 1. Three lines are depicted: a blue dashed line representing the "hidden state mean before gate", a red dotted line for the "hidden state mean after gate", and a green solid line for the "hidden state mean of baseline". The blue dashed line starts at approximately 0 at layer 0, increases to around 0.25 at layer 5, remains relatively stable until layer 17 where it begins to rise again, reaching about 0.75 at layer 19, and then sharply increases to 4.25 at layer 22. The red dotted line begins at 0 at layer 0, slightly increases to around 0.05 by layer 3, and remains relatively stable, ending at approximately 0.1 at layer 22. The green solid line starts at 0 at layer 0 and gradually increases to about 0.1 by layer 22, closely following the trend of the red dotted line.
